_comment: Suite time budget (work-order item B7): per-module wall-time ceilings in seconds, enforced by scripts/run_tests_no_skips.py --budget. Derived from the cloud runner's durations of 2026-11-07 (docs/reference/development-checks.md) with about three times margin for a loaded runner. A ceiling is never a reason to skip or shorten a test: raise it with the measurement that needs it.
